hero.title: Hi, I'm Pablo.
hero.intro: Staff AI/ML Engineer from 🇪🇸 Spain, based in 🇹🇼 Taiwan. I build ML systems for semiconductors and music tools for fun.

engineeringFocus.lead: With a background in EECS, I've studied and worked across the US, Spain, Portugal, China, and Taiwan on:

areas.title: Production ML
areas.description:
Building training and inference pipelines for semiconductors, fraud detection and e-commerce: from fine-tuning pretrained vision models for image defect detection to image inference, customer segmentation, and statistical analysis.
I use CI/CD, MLOps and IaC (e.g. Terraform) to deploy to the cloud (mainly GCP, Oracle, and Nebius).

areas.title: LLMs & Agents
areas.description: Designing agentic systems, MCP servers/tools, and vector databases to help troubleshoot manufacturing defects.

areas.title: Music
areas.description: Research in deep learning for music generation, building hardware for electric guitar, and developing tools for musicians.

coffeeChat.title: Say Hi / Coffee Chat
coffeeChat.description: Interested in machine learning, semiconductors, music technology, or life in Taiwan? Feel free to grab a slot on my calendar to chat.
coffeeChat.mentorship: I've also mentored university students through IMFAHE since 2024.
